summary: Re-review after the revise loop: both fix_tasks genuinely resolved on disk, contract-check ok, AC-1..AC-11 satisfied, raised per_class limit ruled faithful. Approve.
missing_tests: Still open from the first review: no test drives a sink that fails on the SECOND diagnostic write (TEXTO_DE_USO) after the first succeeded. comandos.rs:44-46 does return Fallo there, but every EscritorQueFalla fails on the first byte, so a mutation of that arm survives. fix_task 2 listed this as OPTIONAL and it was not done; low severity because the surface is a stub owned by plan tasks 11-15.

Exact Spanish literal asserted for only 3 of 9 ErrorDeArgumentos Display variants (tests/argumentos.rs::mensajes_de_error_son_literales_en_espanol); the other six are pinned by variant+fields but their message text could be reworded undetected.
No test drives the binary itself (argv[0] skip in main.rs, Salida::estandar wiring); AC-6 verified by inspection only, which the spec allows but a CARGO_BIN_EXE test would pin it.
notes: contract-check ok=true; violations: none. not_checked: forbid.behaviors (checked by hand below). Measured diff main...HEAD over BOTH commits: 9 files, 1299 insertions + 16 deletions = 1315 lines vs max_diff_lines 1350; per_class src/** 631 vs 650, tests/** 515 vs 560, docs/adr/** 123 vs 200, bitacora 46 vs 70. All inside limits.

FIX_TASK 1 (retirar-literal-ipc-del-crate) RESOLVED - verified, not taken on trust. grep -rn 'desvinculada_sesion_cerrada' crates/hexcell-admin/ returns nothing (exit 1). The linea_de_simulacion doc comment (comandos.rs:65-71) now states the principle without naming the IPC cause. The vacuous test los_mensajes_de_simulacion_no_contienen_la_taxonomia_de_sesion_del_ipc is deleted. The SEMANTIC invariant still holds: estado_objetivo maps Retirar -> EstadoDeCelula::Retirada, a control-plane enum owned by HEX-074-a; no IPC session state (activa/reconectando/desvinculada/pausada) is adopted as a cell state anywhere in the crate.

The literal survives at exactly ONE place in the net diff: docs/adr/adr-0036...md:92-95, as a deliberate NEGATIVE architectural statement ('no aparece en ningun sitio de crates/hexcell-admin'), which is now true on disk. The contract scoped the prohibition to crates/hexcell-admin, so docs/ is compliant and this is the right home for the statement.

RESIDUAL (accepted, not a fix_task): deleting that test leaves the no-IPC-taxonomy invariant with no dedicated mechanical guard. Acceptable because the deleted guard was vacuous (constant discriminant, could only ever pass) and the invariant is now carried by a guard with a real discriminant - estado_objetivo_es_exhaustivo_y_nombra_el_destino_correcto plus the wildcard-free matches over Subcomando, which fail red if the target state changes.

FIX_TASK 2 (quitar-modulo-de-pruebas-en-linea) RESOLVED - no #[cfg(test)] module anywhere under crates/hexcell-admin/src/ (the only cfg(test) hit is a doc-comment mention in lib.rs). The two write-failure tests exist in tests/comandos.rs:229-241 and are NOT vacuous: EscritorQueFalla forces a real io::Error, so if ejecutar swallowed it, returned a different code, or panicked, both go red.

CORRECTION to the framing of fix_task 2: the coverage did not MOVE, it was already present. tests/comandos.rs::fallos_de_escritura_se_convierten_en_fallo (lines 178-194, present since commit 1) already exercises all three write-failure cases, including both 'moved' ones - as the first review itself noted when it called the embedded module a duplicate. The two appended tests are exact duplicates of its 2nd and 3rd blocks, and the third embedded test (estandar+simular) was deleted rather than moved because block 1 already covers it. Net effect: nothing lost, ~14 redundant lines gained. The claim that this closes the first review's diagnostic-write-failure missing_tests note is FALSE - that note was about a SECOND-write failure and remains open (carried forward in missing_tests).

RULING on per_class crates/hexcell-admin/src/** raised 480 -> 650: FAITHFUL, not padding or gold-plating. Measured 631. Substance check of all 4 src files: every symbol traces to an AC or a contract clause - 9 ErrorDeArgumentos variants map 1:1 onto the 8 failure kinds the contract's exit-code table enumerates (absent/unknown group, unknown subcommand, unknown/repeated/empty-valued/missing-value flag, flag not admitted, surplus positional), each carrying subcomando context plus a Spanish Display arm (AC-2); six per-subcommand predicates and both --k v / --k=v spellings (AC-3); private-field Invocacion with accessors; a 14-line TEXTO_DE_USO. No dead code, no unrequested abstraction, no --help/--ayuda, no --domain/--waba, no Docker construction, no persistence, no interactive prompt, no README refresh. The repo-mandated Spanish doc-comment discipline structurally inflates line counts. 480 was under-sized for a six-subcommand grammar with nine typed rejections.

PROCESS CAVEAT on that raise (recorded, not blocking): amending a limit after seeing the diff is a real hazard of fitting the contract to the work. Mitigating facts - max_diff_lines was NOT raised and still binds (1315 < 1350), no other per_class was touched, max_files_changed unchanged at 9, and the substance check above found no padding to hide.

AC-9 verified by inspection: docs/adr/adr-0036-contrato-de-analisis-de-argumentos-y-modo-de-simulacion.md exists (Vigente 2026-09-13, CONSUMES adr-0034 without reopening it), 0036 is the next free number on disk (0035 was last), and it is appended as the LAST row of the docs/adr/README.md table with no existing row edited, moved or renumbered. Both land in commit 4a9d190, the same commit as the code.

AC-10 verified by inspection: docs/bitacora-de-descartes.md gains D-52 (clap, argh, pico-args, structopt grouped under one number per the D-51 precedent) with 'Descartado: 2026-09-13', a per-library REASON, 'Registro normativo', and an explicit REOPENING CONDITION (a future subcommand whose grammar the hand-rolled parser stops covering legibly, and even then the reopening must justify a library over a second in-crate module). Index row added and 'Ultima actualizacion' bumped to D-52; the diff adds only, editing or deleting no existing D-NN. Same commit as the code.

acceptance-coverage: AC-9 and AC-10 reported as gaps - FALSE gaps by design (documentation artifacts verified by reviewer inspection, as 00-spec.yaml constraints state explicitly); AC-1..AC-8 and AC-11 covered.

Invariants re-checked on the combined diff: no Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock change; cargo tree -p hexcell-admin shows exactly serde 1.0.229 + serde_json 1.0.151; cargo tree -p hexcell-core shows zero external dependencies; no forbid file touched (codigo_de_salida.rs, salida.rs, estado_de_celula.rs, src/docker/**, their tests, sidecar/**, deploy/**, PRD/STATUS/plan/protocolo-ipc, ci.yml all absent from the changed-file list). No panic!/unwrap()/expect()/process::exit/println!/eprintln! on any production path - the only write! calls are Display impls into a Formatter, and unwrap_or is total. argumentos[0], argumentos[1], argumentos[2..] and main.rs's [1..] are each guarded by a preceding length check.

Three-outcome contract verified: parse error -> UsoIncorrecto (2) with Spanish diagnostic on the diagnostic sink and an empty standard sink; valid + --simular -> Exito (0) with the exact planned-action line on the standard sink and an empty diagnostic sink; valid without --simular -> NoImplementadoTodavia (3) on the diagnostic sink; any sink io::Error -> Fallo (1). Asserted with two independent in-memory buffers and exact expected bytes. No side effect by construction: ejecutar's signature admits only the parse result and &mut Salida - no ClienteDocker, no path, no clock, no network handle - and the module imports no fs/net/docker.

Language/commits: identifiers, comments, doc comments and docs in Spanish (only the PRD-fixed wire names cell/pause/unpause/terminate/rebind/list/status and --id stay English). BOTH commits are Spanish conventional commits (feat(admin), fix(admin)) and a case-insensitive grep for co-authored-by / generated with / claude / anthropic over both messages returns 0 - no AI attribution. Dates absolute (2026-09-13).

Low-severity observation, no fix_task: 'cell pause --id --simular' consumes --simular as the VALUE of --id (tomar_valor does not reject a flag-shaped value), so an operator typo yields exit 3 instead of exit 2. No AC or contract clause covers it and the behaviour matches GNU convention; flagged for plan tasks 11-15 when the subcommands gain real effects.

Low-severity observation, no fix_task: in tests/comandos.rs::errores_de_analisis..., diagnostico.contains('--id') collapses three distinct variants (FaltaValorDeOpcion, OpcionRepetida, OpcionNoAdmitida) onto one coarse assertion. Not a real hole - tests/argumentos.rs pins each of those cases to its exact variant with exact fields - but the comandos-layer assertion alone would not discriminate them.

05-validation.json re-saved after the fixes: overall_result=passed, four verify.commands exit 0 (cargo build --workspace, cargo test -p hexcell-admin with 59 tests across 7+13+10+8+15+6, cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings).

Deferred by design and therefore NOT counted as defects: command idempotency, control-plane state persistence, reconciliation against Docker, and the number-substitution audit record in cell status (plan tasks 11-15).
